about: The featured nights' Spotify picks that the match rules (packages/core/src/matchRules.ts) cannot prove are the catalogue row's recording. Kept here, keyed by the featured night's song id, so every featured uri is cached (test/streams.test.ts); never read into the catalogue, so the row plays nothing from them and the stream audit (tracks.json) stays clean. Move a record into tracks.json once a dated title, the album years or the length proves the take.
